Deal Breakers

Be honest. Your non-negotiables help us protect your time and energy.

Imagine you're writing a personal ad — describe the person you're looking for: their age range, physical appearance (height, build, skin tone, style...), personality, energy, the way they carry themselves, their lifestyle, their ambitions. Be as specific as you can.

Section 11 of 11

Complete Your Profile

Photos, a short video, and a few last questions to complete your profile.

⏰  This section takes approximately 5–7 minutes

We will ask you for 5 to 10 recent photos and, if you wish, a short video (around 1 minute) where you introduce yourself naturally.

Nothing to do right now: once your profile is sent, you will be able to send us your photos and video in one tap, by WhatsApp or email.

For large videos, WeTransfer (free) to love@nubianconnections.com works perfectly.

Before any introduction, we hold a short video call to confirm your identity. It is our commitment to you and to the people you will meet.

No recent photos? That is very common.

Professional photos make a real difference and we warmly recommend them — but lovely photos taken with a phone are perfectly fine. What works best:

  • A smiling portrait in natural daylight
  • A full-length photo, taken by a friend
  • A photo of you doing something you love
  • Avoid sunglasses, group photos and heavy filters

Beyond checkboxes and criteria — describe what you are genuinely hoping to find. What does love look like for you? What kind of connection are you seeking?

How do you picture your daily life together? What does a fulfilling partnership look and feel like?
